title: FI-hardened page-124 / page-123 record codec: expanded-bit encoding, replicated halfwords, and 'blank page is ill-formed'
threat: Attempt-counter bypass by fault: page 124 encodes 'erased = 0 attempts' (`[0xFF;16]` blank, `[0x00;16]` consumed, any non-0xFF byte counts). A glitch on the flash read path that returns 0xFF (the exact Trezor 2019 voltage-glitch outcome, 'read the PIN entry counter as 0xFFFFFFFF') decodes as a fresh counter; the forward/reverse double scan narrows but does not remove this because both scans share the same 'is it 0xFF' predicate.
proposal: Port Trezor's blockwise (U5 ECC-flash) scheme to the page-124 QW record and to page-123 16-B increments: encode the per-record value bit-wise (1->01, 0->10) into a 16-bit word replicated across all eight halfwords of the quad-word; decode every halfword, require the `(c ^ (c<<1)) & 0xAAAA == 0xAAAA` well-formedness on each, and require all eight to agree, else route to the fault handler. Make the erased state ill-formed: `pin_attempts_reset` erases AND writes `expand(0)` as record 0, so an all-0xFF page is a fault, not 'zero attempts' (Trezor `pin_logs_init` verifies compress(expand(fails))==fails before writing). Keep the bump as 'program the next blank QW' so the one-program-per-attempt wear property is preserved. Implement the codec in a pure workspace crate (next to `pqsigner-fi`) and add Kani harnesses for encode/decode round-trip, ill-formed detection, and scan monotonicity (#397).
rationale: `flash.rs:764-792` documents the layout ('Programmed sentinel [0x00;16]. Blank sentinel [0xFF;16]'; 'any non-blank pattern marks consumed'); `flash.rs:824-836` double-scan returns 32 on disagreement but both scans agree on a uniformly-faulted 0xFF read. No Kani harness touches page 124 (grep over kani::proof files). Trezor explicitly chose this simplified codec for U5 because an SE counter is primary and flash is ECC — pq1 is in the same position, so the full guard-key scheme is not needed.
repo_evidence: grep kani::proof -> no harness over pin_attempts_*
vendor_precedent: Trezor storage/pinlogs_blockwise.h:8-26 (expand/compress with ill-formed check), :27-73 (all halfwords must agree; init verifies round-trip); docs/storage/index.md 'PIN entry counter protection'.
risks: Changes a flash layout that the first-boot blank-check (first_boot/mod.rs:200-204) and reconcile read; must keep 'blank page after RDP-2 self-lock' as a distinct, expected state (write expand(0) during Phase B). Page 123 records are also parsed by host tooling; version the codec. A fault that hits the reset-write of expand(0) must fail closed (treat as locked), which the halt-sink review (#835) warns can burn budget if done carelessly.
